title: Lemerig language - Wikipedia
text: Lemerig is an Oceanic language spoken on Vanua Lava, in Vanuatu. The language is no longer actively spoken, having receded in favour of its neighbors, including Vera'a and possibly also Mwotlap or Vurës. [1]
